changes.title: Draw a modern remake of the navigation and the polished pages
changes.detail:
A new canvas, 23-modern-remake, with ten boards drawn by design/source/modern/boards.py:

- One navigation pane in place of the rail and the tab strip, shown docked left, collapsed to icons, docked to the top as one bar with search, and floating over the overview with its position menu open, plus every position expanded and collapsed with the profile settings. - Settings (light and dark), the automation editor with one floating action bar, automation history with one commit action, the colour tool, and apps without an app store. - Phone screens, light and dark: rows as cards, open pages as a sheet.

changes.title: Tab strip: collapse to icons, float anywhere; fixes from viewing build 137
changes.detail:
The tab strip can now go anywhere and get out of the way:

- Collapse: a button at the start of the strip (and an entry in its menu, and a switch in the profile) shows each tab as its icon only, the name in the tooltip and to screen readers. On a side or floating it becomes a 64 pixel column and the page takes the room back; on the top or bottom it stays one bar. - Float anywhere: a fifth position beside the four edges. The strip becomes a card over the page that takes no room from it. Drag it by its handle, or focus the handle and use the arrow keys (Shift moves further). The place is stored as a share of the window, so it stays put on another window size, and it is always kept fully on screen. - A Tab strip position button beside the collapse button opens the strip's menu, which before was only reachable by right-clicking empty space in the strip. - Both choices are saved per strip and synced with the other tab settings. Pure functions for the stored values have tests.
